newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungarian shares seen firmer, backed by strong dlr.
newsitem.headline: Hungarian shares seen firmer, backed by strong dlr.

text.p: 0710 GMT - The Hungarian share market is expected to open in a positive tone on Monday, traders said.
* Traders expected the rising trend to continue, although some investors may decide to unload their papers at current high levels.
* The market's upward move is seen backed by a strong dollar which makes Hungarian shares cheaper.
* Retailer Fotex, suspended on Friday due to excessive rise, is expected to continue its rally.
* On Friday the BUX index finished at 6,784.66 points, up 53.09.
